description:
A moderately difficult trail to Sunken-Dibble Pass, where the trail forks to either Tanglefoot Lake or Cliff Lake.
This is a good horse trail. The trail head is located at the base of the Steeples, east of Horseshoe Lake.
directions: Commencing at the Fort Steele Historic Park, proceed north on Hwy 93/95 for 300 metres. Turn right onto the Wardner - Ft. Steele Road. Follow this road for 10.7 km. Turn left onto the Horseshoe Lake Road. Horseshoe Lake is within 500 metres of the turn-off. Keep right to the Sunken Creek Trail head.
title: Lost/Sunken Creek Trail
